name: Verallia Societe Anonyme
summary: Verallia Société Anonyme produces and sells glass packaging products for beverages and food industry worldwide. It provides bottles and jars for still and sparkling wines, spirits, food products, beers, and nonalcoholic beverages. The company was founded in 1827 and is headquartered in Courbevoie, France. Verallia Société Anonyme operates as a former subsidiary of Horizon Investment Holdings S.à.r.l.
